description: Computer Engineering at NC State. Experience and projects in software engineering, backend systems, computer architecture, and applied AI.
intro: I’m a Computer Engineering student at NC State interested in software engineering, computer architecture, and applied AI. Currently, I’m an SDE intern at AWS, building agentic applications for data center planning.
about: I enjoy understanding how systems work and finding ways to improve them. My interests span software development, backend services, computer architecture, and applied AI.
I’m open to a broad range of software engineering roles. I’m especially drawn to work that lets me solve practical problems, learn unfamiliar technologies, and improve performance or reliability.

experience.summary: Developing a full-stack agentic application that turns natural-language requests into data center planning inputs.
contributions: Built a dynamic schema and dependency-graph generator for 80+ configuration files, with Pydantic validation and user approval for coordinated edits.
Developing the application with Bedrock AgentCore, Strands, a web UI, and CI/CD.
Identified retained incomplete S3 multipart uploads and automated cleanup to prevent approximately $800/month in storage costs.

experience.summary: Developed backend services and monitoring for cloud security infrastructure.
contributions: Built a Go pre-scan filter that excluded approximately 40% of incoming Docker images as unprocessable, reducing Lambda failure rates from 30% to 1%.
Built a Python service aggregating vulnerability scan results across 40 production targets, integrating CloudWatch and Slack APIs.
Implemented Grafana failure detection and alerting across 10 production security services, resolving IAM barriers to cross-region monitoring.

experience.summary: Developed embedded software for a next-generation control-system prototype.
contributions: Led C/C++ development across 5+ product lines with direct customer input.
Worked on FreeRTOS task scheduling to improve responsiveness under real-time constraints.
